name: text-chunker
title: Text Chunker
description: Recursive text splitter for RAG. Splits documents on paragraph, sentence and word boundaries into chunks of a target size, with overlap.

usage.python:
from kura_rs import text_chunker

chunker = text_chunker.Chunker(size=1000, overlap=200)

for chunk in chunker.split(document):
    index.add(chunk.text, chunk.range)
